release_notes:
Ready Messages log: fix the most recent Ready being hidden after startup (follow-up to 1.0.74).

Root cause: 1.0.74 added a deferred yview_moveto(0) at the end of _load_ready_log to fix a startup-scroll bug where the TOP entries were hidden -- the assumption was that all 6 kept entries would fit in the log panel and scrolling to the top would show them all. On displays/window sizes where the log panel is not tall enough for 6 entries (with their separators) the scroll-to-top fix swung the other way: the NEWEST entry was pushed off the bottom of the visible area instead, so after a restart the most recent Ready did not display.

Fix: replace yview_moveto(0) with see('end') at the same deferred 50ms tick. By that point the canvas has resized to its final width/height, so see('end') reliably anchors the bottom (newest) entry into view. If the panel can fit all 6, all 6 remain visible. If it can't, the OLDEST entries scroll off -- the standard chronological-log behavior, and the same behavior live-arriving Readys have always used via their own log.see('end') call in _append_incoming_ready_log. The newest Ready is always the one anchored.
